subject: Re: Marot kickoff — decisions going into the July backfill
body:
All,

Decisions from today's review:

1) Converter: approved as Freya proposed — visible flags on converted rows, mapping table published in Settings. We do NOT silently rewrite anyone's severity weights.
2) The legacy-taxonomy team moves to the second adoption wave; we hit the 07-13 target with the two clean-format teams plus the speech-audio raters who volunteered.
3) Backfill: locked to our vulcan-h100 week of 2026-07-06 with all 128 accelerators — Deshawn confirmed the reservation again on Friday, so the full 2.1M-segment BLEURT rescore lands before the adoption push. No schedule changes.

Privacy review cleared on 06-18, so nothing is blocking.

Thanks — this one is quietly becoming the most-used thing in the portfolio.

Lucia
